slots.image_prompt: A sweeping dark futuristic scene with flowing streams of sky blue neon light and luminous cyan particles cascading through a deep digital void. Geometric hexagonal grid patterns fade into the darkness, with soft volumetric glow effects and subtle depth-of-field blur. The composition evokes a sense of global connectivity and data flowing across dimensions, rendered in ultra-detailed cinematic style with a palette of deep navy black, electric sky blue #2196F3, and accent cyan #00BCD4 highlights.

A deep navy-blue gradient background with abstract geometric light spots and soft bokeh particles drifting in the space. Subtle crystalline facets and faint holographic hexagonal wireframes create a layered sense of depth. Glowing sky blue #2196F3 and cyan #00BCD4 accents emerge from the darkness like distant stars. The overall mood is calm, futuristic, and refined, suitable as an ambient backdrop for a section header in a tech presentation.

An abstract 3D geometric representation of an open book, constructed entirely from luminous sky-blue neon wireframe lines and translucent glowing planes. The pages curve outward into the darkness, emitting soft light trails and floating particle clusters. The composition symbolizes knowledge expanding and flowing into the world. Rendered against a deep black backdrop with subtle cyan #00BCD4 edge highlights and volumetric light scattering. Futuristic, minimalist, editorial style.

A futuristic arrangement of five floating holographic book-shaped forms organized in an asymmetric grid across a dark void. Each book is a stylized rectangular prism with glowing sky blue #2196F3 wireframe outlines and translucent cyan #00BCD4 cover panels, emitting soft particle halos. Thin neon connector lines weave between them forming a subtle network. The scene conveys a curated collection of knowledge in a tech-forward aesthetic, deep navy background with subtle gradient.

A dark navy background featuring three abstract silhouetted human figures composed of glowing sky blue #2196F3 point clouds and geometric line segments, arranged in a wide horizontal formation. Soft luminous auras surround each figure, with faint connecting data streams between them suggesting collaboration. The mood is sophisticated and communal, evoking a digital conference or collective sharing session. Subtle cyan #00BCD4 ambient glow and gentle particle drift in the deep space.

A dark canvas divided into four luminous quadrants, each containing a distinct abstract geometric icon form glowing in sky blue #2196F3 and cyan #00BCD4. The four forms represent different technology domains through pure abstract symbolism: one radiating outward like a core, one with interlocking modular blocks, one with layered flowing curves, and one with crystalline algorithmic structures. Soft neon outlines and particle glows connect the quadrants. Futuristic editorial aesthetic, deep black background.

Abstract visualization of community conversation flowing through a dark space. Softly glowing sky blue #2196F3 chat-bubble-like geometric forms float in an organic cluster, connected by thin luminous data threads and accompanied by faint avatar-shaped point clusters. Cyan #00BCD4 particle effects drift between the bubbles suggesting active interaction. The composition feels dynamic yet calm, with a tall vertical composition suited for a side-panel decoration in a tech presentation.

A vast deep-space background with luminous sky blue #2196F3 light paths and energy streams converging from the edges and extending toward a distant glowing horizon point. The light trails form subtle roadmap-like branching patterns with increasing density toward the vanishing point, suggesting a journey into the future. Soft cyan #00BCD4 gradient glow and scattered star-like particles fill the void. Cinematic, aspirational, futuristic mood.
